disposition.reason: This docket appeals a water quality certification issued by the Agency of Natural Resources for the Morrisville Hydroelectric Project, a state-agency permit, not a municipal land-use decision; the subject is a hydroelectric facility, not new housing.

evidence.quote: This is an appeal from a water quality certification issued by the Agency of Natural Resources to Morrisville Water and Light for the Morrisville Hydroelectric Project

judgments.note: All seven documents concern the ANR § 401 water quality certification for the Morrisville hydroelectric project (FERC licensing); no municipal decision or housing is involved. Scope established from docs 1-2; remaining text not read in full since exclusion is clear.

history.note: Excluded: ANR water quality certification appeal for a hydroelectric project.
